value.rationale: The motivating paper establishes existence of every regular rotation and historic cluster interval but no size of its realization sets. A complete exact Hausdorff spectrum for those natural infinite families is a nontrivial quantitative resolution. It also proves the extreme rotation levels and even the full historic interval have strictly positive dimension, with an explicit p-dependent value; neither existence nor full ambient entropy determines that fact. The dimension function and endpoint threshold are intrinsic to the established random dynamical example, not arbitrary parameters or a routine finite enumeration.
